name: Marcus
description: A street vendor who sets up near the community center most mornings. He knows everyone who passes through this block.

dialogue.default: You new around here? Don't see many people walking around taking notes.
dialogue.after_record_0001: Art shows, huh? Used to be more of those around here. People stopped showing up. Or maybe the shows stopped happening. Hard to say which came first.
dialogue.after_record_0003: Cultured Concepts — yeah, I know them. Good people. They do a lot that doesn't make the news. That event badge you found? That's just the surface.
dialogue.after_sync: You've been busy. I can tell. People remember more when someone's actually paying attention.
